argument_markdown:
Put X_{g,n}=M_{g,n}. All cohomology has rational coefficients.

1. Pure-weight finite-generation formula.

For each forgetful map pi_i:X_{g,n}->X_{g,n-1}, define

Phi_{g,n}^k := sum_i pi_i^* W_k H^k(X_{g,n-1})

and define

Psi_{g,n}^k := sum_i psi_i Phi_{g,n}^{k-2}.

For g>=2, there is an isomorphism of pure weight-k Hodge structures

W_k H^k(X_{g,n})/(Phi_{g,n}^k+Psi_{g,n}^k)
  ~= direct_sum_{|lambda|=n} W_k H^{k-n}(M_g;V_lambda) tensor V_{lambda^T}.   (1)

Here V_lambda is the irreducible symplectic local system of weight |lambda| and V_{lambda^T} is the corresponding rational symmetric-group representation.

For completeness, (1) follows as follows. Let pi:C->M_g be the universal closed curve and let f:C^n->M_g be its n-fold fibre product. The open inclusion X_{g,n}->C^n induces a surjection on the lowest weight W_k in degree k: after taking a common smooth normal-crossings compactification, W_k of either smooth open is the image of the compactification cohomology, and the restriction map factors that image. Since f is smooth and proper, its Leray spectral sequence degenerates at E_2. Kunneth therefore gives

H^k(C^n)=direct_sum H^p(M_g;R^{i_1}pi_*Q tensor ... tensor R^{i_n}pi_*Q),

where p+i_1+...+i_n=k and each i_s belongs to {0,1,2}. Pullbacks from C^{n-1} span precisely the summands having some i_s=0. Modulo those summands, multiplication by psi_s spans the summands having i_s=2, because psi_s restricts to the nonzero canonical class in H^2 of the fibre. Thus the remaining term has i_1=...=i_n=1 and is

H^{k-n}(M_g;(R^1 pi_*Q)^{tensor n}).

The Kunneth component of each diagonal class Delta_{ij}, which restricts to zero on X_{g,n}, inserts the symplectic form into the i-th and j-th tensor positions. Quotienting by these contraction images gives the symplectically traceless decomposition

direct_sum_{|lambda|=n} V_lambda tensor V_{lambda^T}.

All maps are morphisms of mixed Hodge structures. Since V_lambda has weight n, taking weight k gives exactly (1). This independently establishes the specialized input used below.

2. The primitive six-marking quotient vanishes.

Apply (1) with (g,n,k)=(6,6,26). Its right side is

direct_sum_{|lambda|=6} W_26 H^20(M_6;V_lambda) tensor V_{lambda^T}.   (2)

Harer's virtual-cohomological-dimension formula gives vcd(Mod_6)=4*6-5=19. This bound applies to every rational local coefficient module: choose a torsion-free normal finite-index subgroup Gamma of Mod_6. It has cohomological dimension 19, hence H^20(Gamma;V_lambda)=0. The Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence for Gamma normal in Mod_6 has finite quotient; its positive-degree rational cohomology vanishes, so H^20(Mod_6;V_lambda)=H^20(Gamma;V_lambda)^{Mod_6/Gamma}=0. Therefore every summand in (2) is zero, and

W_26 H^26(X_{6,6})=Phi_{6,6}^{26}+Psi_{6,6}^{26}.   (3)

3. The degree-26 pullback part vanishes.

For five ordered markings,

vcd(PMod_{6,5})=4*6-4+5=25.

The same finite-index argument gives H^26(X_{6,5})=0. Consequently

Phi_{6,6}^{26}=sum_i pi_i^*W_26H^26(X_{6,5})=0.   (4)

Combining (3) and (4),

W_26H^26(X_{6,6})=Psi_{6,6}^{26}.   (5)

4. The remaining psi-multiple part has type Q(-13).

The verified CKgP theorem THM-0005 applies to X_{6,5}, because 5=c(6). It gives surjectivity of the cycle-class map onto every lowest-weight group and A^*(X_{6,5})=R^*(X_{6,5}). Hence, in degree 24,

W_24H^24(X_{6,5}) ~= Q(-12)^{direct_sum a}

for some finite a: every generating codimension-12 cycle class has Hodge type (12,12), and every subquotient of their span has the same type. It follows that Phi_{6,6}^{24}, being a sum of pullback images of this group, is a finite direct sum of Q(-12).

Each psi_i is an algebraic codimension-one class of Hodge type Q(-1). Therefore the cup-product maps

Q(-1) tensor Phi_{6,6}^{24} -> W_26H^26(X_{6,6})

have images that are finite direct sums of Q(-13). By definition their sum is Psi_{6,6}^{26}. Equation (5) consequently exhibits W_26H^26(X_{6,6}) as a quotient of a finite direct sum of Q(-13). Since the target is pure of weight 26, equivalently because polarizable pure Hodge structures of fixed weight are semisimple, there is a finite r>=0 such that

W_26H^26(M_{6,6};Q) ~= Q(-13)^{direct_sum r}.   (6)

5. Conversion to the exact Borel-Moore target.

The smooth Deligne-Mumford stack M_{6,6} has complex dimension

d=3*6-3+6=21.

Poincare duality for smooth finite-type Deligne-Mumford stacks gives an isomorphism of mixed Hodge structures

W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q)
  ~= W_26H^26(M_{6,6};Q)(21).

Using (6) and Q(-13)(21)=Q(8), this becomes

W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) ~= Q(8)^{direct_sum r}.

Thus the exact group is a finite direct sum of Q(8), as asserted. The case r=0 is allowed. No non-Tate summand survives.

claims.justification: The smooth-proper Leray decomposition for the n-fold universal curve separates the R^0, R^1, and R^2 Kunneth factors. Pullbacks remove factors R^0, psi-multiples remove factors R^2, and diagonal classes remove symplectic contractions from (R^1)^{tensor n}; symplectic Schur-Weyl decomposition gives the stated primitive quotient. All constructions respect mixed Hodge structures and weights.
claims.statement: For g>=2, W_kH^k(M_{g,n})/(Phi_{g,n}^k+Psi_{g,n}^k) is isomorphic to the direct sum over |lambda|=n of W_kH^{k-n}(M_g;V_lambda) tensor V_{lambda^T}.

claims.justification: CLM-0135-1 identifies it with a sum of W_26H^20(M_6;V_lambda) for |lambda|=6. Since vcd(Mod_6)=19, degree-20 cohomology vanishes for every rational local coefficient module.
Every summand is pulled back from H^26(M_{6,5}); this group vanishes because 26 exceeds vcd(PMod_{6,5})=25.
THM-0005 applies at n=5=c(6), giving CKgP, tautological Chow, and surjectivity of codimension-12 cycle classes onto the pure weight-24 group.
claims.statement: W_24H^24(M_{6,5};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-12).

claims.justification: By CLM-0135-2 and CLM-0135-3 the target equals Psi. This subspace is generated by products of psi_i of type Q(-1) with pullbacks of the Q(-12)-sum from CLM-0135-4, hence is a quotient of a finite direct sum of Q(-13).
claims.statement: Psi_{6,6}^{26}, and hence W_26H^26(M_{6,6};Q), is a finite direct sum of Q(-13).

claims.justification: Poincare duality in dimension 21 identifies it with W_26H^26(M_{6,6};Q)(21), and Q(-13)(21)=Q(8). Apply CLM-0135-5.
claims.statement: W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8).

failed_approaches_addressed.subject: No vanishing is inferred from 26=vcd(M_{6,6}); virtual cohomological dimension is applied only to H^20(M_6;V_lambda), where 20>19, and H^26(M_{6,5}), where 26>25.
The local-system obstruction is computed by the pure-weight quotient formula rather than renamed through a forgetful Leray sequence.
No undecorated top-weight graph complex, compactification degree-16 assertion, point count, finite-cover Tate inference, or Casnati-Ekedahl support-exhaustion assertion is used.
The CE support graph is bypassed by an independent computation of the whole exact target, not used as an unverified assembly.

methods_used: Kunneth decomposition for the universal curve
virtual cohomological dimension with local coefficients

new_inputs.evidence: The prohibited inference at the target degree remains unused. The independently proved SRC-0002 Lemma 3.1 quotient formula first isolates a primitive quotient in H^20(M_6;V_lambda), where degree 20 is strictly above vcd 19; THM-0005 then controls the complementary pullback and psi terms. This new structural input makes the residual use of vcd valid and resolves, rather than merely renames, the exact target.

novelty_claims.statement: Specializing the supplied Canning-Larson-Payne pure-weight quotient formula at (g,n,k)=(6,6,26) places every primitive six-marking term in local-system degree 20 on M_6, strictly above vcd(Mod_6)=19.

After the primitive quotient and degree-26 pullbacks vanish, the entire exact ordinary target is generated by psi-multiples of the verified Tate group W_24H^24(M_{6,5}), giving a direct proof of the full target without the CE support-filtration route.

summary: The pure-weight finite-generation formula of Canning-Larson-Payne identifies the quotient of W_26 H^26(M_{6,6}) by pullbacks and psi-multiples with a sum of H^20(M_6;V_lambda) for |lambda|=6. Every such group vanishes because vcd(Mod_6)=19. The degree-26 pullback part also vanishes because vcd(PMod_{6,5})=25, while the remaining psi-multiple part is Tate because W_24 H^24(M_{6,5}) is algebraic and of type Q(-12) by the verified CKgP theorem. Thus W_26 H^26(M_{6,6}) is a finite direct sum of Q(-13), and Poincare duality with twist (21) gives the asserted direct sum of Q(8).
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
